timeline.subtitle: Our history
timeline.title: A journey of innovation and commitment
timeline.m02Text: Grupo NUTEC began its industrial processes in Querétaro, founding a plant with 100% technology imported from Europe.
timeline.m03Text: Winning 35% of the Mexican swine feed market led the Group to diversify into the pet market, always following its philosophy of high quality, technology, and innovation.
timeline.m04Text: We launched a new industrial unit as a result of a partnership with Grupo CCPA of France, creating our EURONUTEC feed plant.
timeline.m05Text: Brand positioning, scientific advances, innovative packaging, and commercial expansion.

policy.subtitle: Our commitment
policy.title: Integral Policy
policy.body: At Grupo NUTEC, customer satisfaction is our top priority, which is why every team member is committed to meeting applicable product, legal, and regulatory requirements for quality, safety, security, health, and environmental standards during the manufacturing, storage, and distribution of premixes, livestock feed, and pet food.
policy.bodyTwo: Inspired by our dream, the Integral System guarantees continuous improvement, reinforcing our commitment to accident prevention, environmental protection, and the well-being of all our team members.

hero.title: We nourish with conscious love
hero.description: Four initiatives through which NUPEC gives back to the country, to communities, and to animals part of what they have given us.

terapias.subtitle: We nourish hope for a better future
terapias.title: Assisted therapies
terapias.description: At NUPEC we collaborate with Fundación Movimiento INCASÁRA to help people who require animal-assisted intervention due to need, condition, or illness. Through complementary therapies, animal-assisted intervention specialists use trained dogs and horses to improve health, foster education, and achieve emotional balance in people.
terapias.descriptionTwo: NUPEC works as a cause-driven product: a percentage of every purchase goes toward funding these animal-assisted therapies, improving the quality of life of those who receive them.

loboMexicano.subtitle: We nourish with conscious love
loboMexicano.title: Mexican wolf conservation
loboMexicano.description: NUPEC is part of the efforts to preserve the Mexican wolf (Canis lupus baileyi), one of the most threatened species, nearly extinct in the wild due to decades of human persecution and hunting. We believe the key to the future is preserving our species, which is why we support foundations dedicated to its conservation.
loboMexicano.descriptionTwo: Since pre-Hispanic Mexico, the Mexican wolf has been considered a magical animal, associated with deities such as Xólotl and Chantico. Its ancestral value and its role in the balance of Mexican ecosystems are reason enough to save it from extinction.

rescate.subtitle: We nourish extraordinary heroes
rescate.title: We feed rescue dogs
rescate.description: We are part of one of the noblest projects in the world: saving lives. That's why we sponsor rescue dogs with food and continuous training, supporting the heroes who respond during natural disasters, such as the K-SAR handler-and-dog teams, a specialized search-and-rescue group that played a key role after the September 19 earthquake in Mexico City.
rescate.descriptionTwo: Their training — which takes one to two years and continues throughout their working life — teaches them to air-scent and discriminate human odors amid rubble, smoke, and noise. Breeds such as the German shepherd, Belgian malinois, and Labrador retriever stand out for their courage, agility, and independence in every rescue.

comercioNacional.subtitle: We nourish lasting relationships
comercioNacional.title: We support national trade
comercioNacional.description: At NUPEC we recognize the commitment of our national suppliers, trained and dedicated to quality and innovation. We develop training plans in raw materials, quality process engineering, business planning, and coaching, strengthening commercial and strategic relationships with our partners in Mexico.
comercioNacional.descriptionTwo: Our special "Con Amor de México" edition pays tribute to our origins with Otomí art from Guanajuato, Michoacán, and Tlaxcala. As a leading Querétaro-based company in specialized canine nutrition, we have more than 600 Mexican professionals, including scientists, veterinarians, and animal nutrition specialists.

sanuren.title: Studies and tests behind every formula
sanuren.subtitle: At the SANUREN Center we apply rigorous scientific protocols before any formula reaches the market.
sanuren.imageAlt: SANUREN Center laboratory - animal nutrition testing
sanuren.digestibilityDesc: We evaluate the real digestibility of each formula in our own facilities with volunteer animals under certified veterinary supervision. Our results exceed 90% apparent digestibility coefficient.
sanuren.palatabilityDesc: We measure food acceptance through double-bowl tests and voluntary intake recording. We ensure every product exceeds market reference standards.
sanuren.safetyDesc: More than 75 control points per batch: microbiology, heavy metals, mycotoxins, and ingredient traceability from supplier to final packaging.
sanuren.efficacyDesc: Therapeutic formulas validated with real-patient follow-up in collaboration with veterinary universities and partner clinics. Published data available for veterinarians.
sanuren.traceabilityDesc: Plant certified to international standards. Each batch has complete records of raw materials, processing, and distribution, guaranteeing full transparency.
